crossRefs.note: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.
translations.bsb: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
translations.kjv: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
translations.asv: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.
